mentions.heading: Failure of our third party suppliers to perform could adversely affect our results of operations.
mentions.detail: Could not obtain sufficient silicon wafers from foundry partners during 2022 shortage; outsourcing costs rise; long-term supply agreements with key partners
mentions.quote: For example, as part of the industry-wide shortage of semiconductors during 2022 we could not obtain sufficient silicon wafers from our foundry partners to meet the demand for our products, causing us not to fully supply the demand for our products, and negatively affecting our results of operations.

mentions.heading: Disruptions in our relationships with any one of our key customers could adversely affect our business.
mentions.detail: Substantial revenue from top customers including distributors; no names or percentages given
mentions.quote: A substantial portion of our revenue is derived from our top customers, including our distributors. We cannot guarantee that we will be able to generate similar levels of revenue from our largest customers in the future.

mentions.heading: We receive subsidies and grants in certain countries, and a reduction in governmental funding or demands for repayment could increase our costs.
mentions.detail: Receives government subsidies and grants in some countries; agencies could recover subsidies if grant conditions unmet
mentions.quote: In such event that we don't meet the subsidies grant conditions, such government agencies could seek to recover such subsidies from us, and they could cancel or reduce other subsidies we receive from them.

mentions.heading: Certain natural disasters may negatively impact our business; climate change may increase natural disasters.
mentions.risk_name: Natural disaster and climate operational disruption
mentions.detail: Cites flooding, heavy precipitation, earthquakes, volcanic eruptions, nuclear disasters; climate change increasing frequency
mentions.quote: Environmental and other disasters, such as flooding, heavy precipitation large earthquakes, volcanic eruptions or nuclear or other disasters, or a combination thereof may negatively impact our business.
